info.title: Polymarket WebSocket Streams API
info.description:
Polymarket WebSocket streaming API.

## Connection

```
wss://api.struct.to/ws
```

## Authentication

**API key** — pass via header or query param:
```
X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>
```
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?api-key=<your-api-key>
```

**Public-key JWT** — for `pk_jwt_*` keys. Your users authenticate with a JWT you sign; credits are charged to your org.
```
Authorization: Bearer <end-user-jwt>
```
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?token=<end-user-jwt>
```

## Application compression (zstd)

Negotiate once at WebSocket upgrade (connection-scoped; applies to all room subscriptions on that connection):
```
X-Ws-Compression: zstd
```
Preferred. Query fallback:
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?compression=zstd
```
Omit both for uncompressed text frames (default). Unsupported values fail the upgrade with `400`. Subscribe-body `compression` is not used. When enabled, room envelopes arrive as binary frames of zstd-compressed JSON.

## Joining a room

```json
{"type":"join_room","payload":{"room_id":"polymarket_trades"}}
```

## Subscribing

After joining, send a `room_message` with room-specific filters:
```json
{
"type": "room_message",
"payload": {
"room_id": "polymarket_trades",
"message": {"action":"subscribe","condition_ids":["0xabc…"]}
}
}
```

## Keepalive

Send `{"type":"ping"}` every 30s. Server responds with `{"type":"pong"}`. Connections idle for more than 60 seconds are closed.

## Pricing

Billed **per message** at different rates per room. A **1-credit hold** is charged on connect. Fractional credits accumulate and are **rounded up** on disconnect.

| Room | Credits per message |
|---|---|
| `polymarket_trades` (Trades) | 0.002 |
| `polymarket_order_book` (Order Book) | 0.001 |
| `polymarket_asset_prices` (Asset Prices) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_asset_window_updates` (Asset Window Updates) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_market_metrics` (Market Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_event_metrics` (Event Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_tag_metrics` (Tag Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_position_metrics` (Position Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_trader_pnl` (Trader PnL) | 0.1 |
| `polymarket_trader_positions` (Trader Positions) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_holder_metrics` (Holder Metrics) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_accounts` (Accounts) | 0.005 |
| `polymarket_clob_rewards` (CLOB Rewards) | 0.01 |
| `polymarket_events_stream` (Events Stream) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_markets_stream` (Markets Stream) | 0.025 |
| `polymarket_oracle_events` (Oracle Events) | 0.025 |

`pong`, `room_joined`, `room_left`, and error messages are free.

polymarket_asset_prices.title: Asset Prices
polymarket_asset_prices.description:
Real-time crypto-asset price feed (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, BNB, HYPE). Delivers both raw `asset_price_tick` events on every price update and `asset_price_window_update` events at candle open/close boundaries.

**Filter (optional):** `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols to filter by. Empty array subscribes to all symbols (firehose).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_asset_window_updates.title: Asset Window Updates
polymarket_asset_window_updates.description:
Filtered stream of asset-price candle open/close events. Unlike `polymarket_asset_prices`, this room **requires** at least one filter so clients receive only the symbols and/or timeframes they care about.

**Filters (at least one required, unless using the firehose):**
- `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols: `"BTC"`, `"ETH"`, `"SOL"`, `"XRP"`, `"DOGE"`, `"BNB"`, `"HYPE"`
- `timeframes` — candle sizes: `"5m"`, `"15m"`, `"1h"`, `"4h"`, `"1d"` / `"24h"`

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive every window update across all symbols and timeframes. Filters are ignored when `subscribe_all` is set.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_market_metrics.title: Market Metrics
polymarket_market_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics per market condition, aggregated across multiple timeframes (`1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`). One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required unless using the firehose):** `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs. Invalid or malformed IDs are returned in `rejected`.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive metrics updates for every market condition. `condition_ids` are ignored when set; the `timeframes` filter still applies.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_event_metrics.title: Event Metrics
polymarket_event_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics aggregated at the event (parent market group) level, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required unless using the firehose):** `event_slugs` — event slugs (lowercase).

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive metrics updates for every event. `event_slugs` is ignored when set; the `timeframes` filter still applies.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_tag_metrics.title: Tag Metrics
polymarket_tag_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics aggregated by tag, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `tags` — tag labels or slugs, matched case-insensitively.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive metrics updates for every tag. The `tags` filter is ignored when set; the `timeframes` filter still applies.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_position_metrics.title: Position Metrics
polymarket_position_metrics.description:
Real-time volume, trade-count, and OHLC price/probability metrics per outcome-token position, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required unless using the firehose):** `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex).

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive every metrics update across all positions. `position_ids` is ignored when set; the `timeframes` filter still applies.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_position_liquidity.title: Position Liquidity
polymarket_position_liquidity.description:
Real-time USD order-book liquidity per outcome-token position. An event is pushed whenever a position's liquidity changes.

**Filter (optional):** `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex). Omit or send an empty array to receive every position's updates (firehose). When provided, up to 500 ids are accepted.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive every position liquidity update. Filters are ignored when set.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_market_liquidity.title: Market Liquidity
polymarket_market_liquidity.description:
Real-time total USD order-book liquidity per market, summed across its outcome tokens. An event is pushed whenever a market's liquidity changes.

**Filter (optional):** `condition_ids` — 64-char hex market IDs. Omit or send an empty array, or set `subscribe_all: true`, to receive every market's updates (firehose). When provided, up to 500 ids are accepted.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_event_liquidity.title: Event Liquidity
polymarket_event_liquidity.description:
Real-time total USD order-book liquidity per event, summed across its markets. An event is pushed whenever an event's liquidity changes.

**Filter (optional):** `event_slugs` — event slugs. Omit or send an empty array to receive every event's updates (firehose). When provided, up to 500 slugs are accepted.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` (equivalent to sending no event_slugs) to receive every event's liquidity updates. Filters are ignored when set.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl.title: Trader PnL
polymarket_trader_pnl.description:
Real-time profit-and-loss updates for tracked traders. PnL is computed at three granularities — `global` (whole portfolio), `market` (per condition), `category` (per market category) — and each granularity is maintained over four rolling windows: `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`.

Updates are delivered **batched per block**: the server sends one envelope per (grain, family[, timeframe]) per block, carrying a `data` array of every row from that block matching the subscriber's filter. Empty batches are not sent. Each row carries a `dirty_kinds` array naming what triggered it. Full-row envelopes also carry a top-level `timeframe`.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`. Firehose / `subscribe_all` is not supported on this room.

**Optional filters:**
• `update_types` — subset of `["global", "market", "category"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive all three update types.
• `timeframes` — subset of `["1d", "7d", "30d", "lifetime"]`. Omit or leave empty to receive all timeframes. (Tick and resolution batches are window-agnostic and ignore this filter.)
• `dirty_kinds` — subset of `["trade", "price", "window", "market_resolved"]`. Omit, leave empty, or pass `["all"]` to receive every kind (the default). Applied per-row: a row is included only if its `dirty_kinds` intersects this filter.

Any unknown value in `update_types`, `timeframes`, or `dirty_kinds` rejects the entire subscription with an `error` message (values are case-insensitive and trimmed).

**Full-row batches** (trade/window-driven): `trader_global_pnl_batch`, `trader_market_pnl_batch`, `trader_category_pnl_batch`.
**Price-tick batches** (mark-to-market): `trader_global_tick_batch`, `trader_market_tick_batch`, `trader_category_tick_batch`.
**Resolution batches** (market resolved): `trader_global_resolution_batch`, `trader_market_resolution_batch`, `trader_category_resolution_batch`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl_v3_1.title: Trader PnL v3.1
polymarket_trader_pnl_v3_1.description:
Real-time profit-and-loss updates for tracked traders. PnL is computed at three granularities — `global` (whole portfolio), `market` (per condition), `category` (per market category) — and each granularity is maintained over four rolling windows: `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`.

Every PnL row also carries the fee-excluded `raw_realized_pnl_usd` / `raw_unrealized_pnl_usd` / `raw_total_pnl_usd` fields.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`. Firehose / `subscribe_all` is not supported on this room.

**Optional filters:**

• `dirty_kinds` — subset of `["trade", "price", "window", "market_resolved"]`. Omit, leave empty, or pass `["all"]` to receive every kind (the default). Applied per-row: a row is included only if its `dirty_kinds` intersects this filter.

Any unknown value in `update_types`, `timeframes`, or `dirty_kinds` rejects the entire subscription with an `error` message (values are case-insensitive and trimmed).

polymarket_trader_positions.title: Trader Positions
polymarket_trader_positions.summary: Trader position updates — batched per-block fan-out covering trades, price ticks and resolutions
polymarket_trader_positions.description:
Real-time position updates for tracked traders. Updates land in batches: the server sends one envelope per block, carrying every row from that block that matches the subscriber's filter. Empty batches are not sent. Each row's `dirty_kinds` array names what triggered that row's update.

**Envelope types** (selected per-row via `dirty_kinds`):
- `trader_position_batch` — full rows, fired on trades.
- `trader_position_price_batch` — compact price ticks, fired on mark-to-market moves (`dirty_kinds: ["price"]`).
- `trader_position_resolution_batch` — resolution ticks, fired when a position's market resolves (`dirty_kinds: ["position_resolved"]`).

Every envelope includes the `block` number plus a `data` array of rows.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Optional filter:** `dirty_kinds` — subset of `["trade", "price", "position_resolved"]`. Omit, leave empty, or pass `["all"]` to receive every kind (the default). Unknown values reject the subscription. The filter applies per-row: a row is included only if its `dirty_kinds` intersects the filter.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_positions_v3_1.summary: Trader position v3.1 updates — batched per-block fan-out covering trades, price ticks and resolutions
polymarket_trader_positions_v3_1.description:
Real-time position updates for tracked traders. Updates land in batches: the server sends one envelope per block, carrying every row from that block that matches the subscriber's filter. Empty batches are not sent. Each row's `dirty_kinds` array names what triggered that row's update.

**Envelope types** (selected per-row via `dirty_kinds`):
- `trader_position_batch_v3_1` — full rows, fired on trades.

polymarket_trader_pnl_exits.title: Trader Exit Markers
polymarket_trader_pnl_exits.summary: Position exit events for tracked traders — one marker per position close, batched per block, labelled with the exit reason
polymarket_trader_pnl_exits.description:
Real-time position exits for tracked traders, to overlay on the PnL chart. The server sends one envelope per block, carrying every exit from that block that matches the subscriber's filter. Empty batches are not sent.

**Envelope type:** `trader_exit_marker_batch`. The envelope includes the `block` number plus a `data` array of exit rows.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Optional filter:** `reasons` — subset of `["resolved_win", "resolved_loss", "sold_win", "sold_loss"]`. Omit, leave empty, or pass `["all"]` to receive every reason (the default). Unknown values reject the subscription.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive exits for every trader — the `traders` filter is ignored (and not required), while the `reasons` filter still applies.

**Exit reasons:** `resolved_win` / `resolved_loss` — held to market resolution; `sold_win` / `sold_loss` — closed before resolution, win/loss by realized PnL sign.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl_exits_v3_1.title: Trader Exit Markers v3.1
polymarket_trader_pnl_exits_v3_1.summary: Position exit events for tracked traders — one marker per position close, batched per block, labelled with the exit reason. v3.1 rows add raw (fee-excluded) PnL and total fees
polymarket_trader_pnl_exits_v3_1.description:
Real-time position exits for tracked traders, to overlay on the PnL chart. The server sends one envelope per block, carrying every exit from that block that matches the subscriber's filter. Empty batches are not sent. Rows extend the legacy exit marker with `raw_pnl_usd` / `raw_pnl_pct` (fee-excluded PnL, rebased on the fee-free cost basis) and `total_fees`.

**Envelope type:** `trader_exit_marker_batch_v3_1`. The envelope includes the `block` number plus a `data` array of exit rows.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Optional filter:** `reasons` — subset of `["resolved_win", "resolved_loss", "sold_win", "sold_loss"]`. Omit, leave empty, or pass `["all"]` to receive every reason (the default). Unknown values reject the subscription.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive exits for every trader — the `traders` filter is ignored (and not required), while the `reasons` filter still applies.

**Exit reasons:** `resolved_win` / `resolved_loss` — held to market resolution; `sold_win` / `sold_loss` — closed before resolution, win/loss by realized PnL sign.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_holder_metrics.title: Holder Metrics
polymarket_holder_metrics.summary: Position, condition, and event holder metrics updates
polymarket_holder_metrics.description:
Real-time holder metrics updates, batched per block. The server sends separate envelopes for position, condition, and event rows. Subscribe with at least one identifier array. Only the metric families you explicitly filter are delivered.

**Envelope types:** `holder_metrics_position_batch`, `holder_metrics_condition_batch`, `holder_metrics_event_batch`.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive every holder metrics batch across all positions, conditions, and events. Filters are ignored when `subscribe_all` is set.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_accounts.title: Accounts
polymarket_accounts.description:
Real-time balance updates for Polymarket wallet accounts.

Always streams ERC-1155 outcome token (shares) balance changes for subscribed wallets as `accounts_update` events. Opt in to additional token streams via boolean flags:
- `include_usdce: true` — also receive `usdce_update` events (USDCe collateral, V1)
- `include_pusd: true` — also receive `pusd_update` events (pUSD collateral, V2 CLOB)
- `include_matic: true` — also receive `matic_update` events (MATIC gas balance)

**Filter (required):** `wallets` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive balance updates for every wallet — the `wallets` filter is ignored, while the `include_*` flags still gate the extra token streams.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_order_book.title: Order Book
polymarket_order_book.description:
Real-time CLOB orderbook snapshots for Polymarket outcome tokens. Each event contains the full aggregated bid/ask book plus pre-computed derived metrics (best bid/ask, mid price, spread, USD liquidity depth, level counts).

**Filters (max 500 combined, unless using the firehose):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs (market); delivers snapshots for all positions in that market
- `position_ids` — hex token/asset IDs (individual outcome tokens)

**Firehose:** Set `subscribe_all: true` to receive every orderbook snapshot across all markets. Firehose delivery is batched: every 50ms, snapshots are conflated per asset (newest book wins) and sent as a single `order_book_batch` envelope whose `data` is an array of snapshots. Filters are ignored when `subscribe_all` is set.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_clob_rewards.title: CLOB Rewards
polymarket_clob_rewards.description:
Real-time stream of Polymarket CLOB reward configuration changes. Emits events when rewards are added to a market, removed, or updated (e.g. rate changes, sponsor count changes, spread/size threshold changes).

**Filters (optional):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs to watch for reward changes
- `subscribe_all` — set to `true` to receive ALL reward changes across all markets

If neither is provided, no events are delivered.

**Event types:**
- `added` — new reward configuration appeared on a market
- `removed` — reward configuration removed from a market
- `updated` — reward parameters changed (rate, spread, size, sponsors, etc.)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_events_stream.title: Events Stream
polymarket_events_stream.summary: Real-time Polymarket events stream — filter or ids mode, 500ms to 10s cadence
polymarket_events_stream.description:
Low-latency push feed of `PolymarketEvent` rows — same row shape `GET /polymarket/events` returns. The stream sends updates for open events as market activity and event metrics change.

**Seeding:** No initial snapshot is pushed on subscribe. Clients seed local state from `GET /polymarket/events` and then apply deltas from this stream.

**Subscription model:** A client has up to 8 active slots per room (4 cadences × 2 modes). Re-subscribing to the same `(interval_ms, mode)` replaces the previous subscription. Unsubscribe one slot with `action: "unsubscribe" + interval_ms + mode`, or clear everything with `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

**Cadence (`interval_ms`):** `500`, `1000`, `3000`, or `10000`. Each cadence is a separate flush bucket — ids/filters subscribed at 500ms see updates up to 2× per second, 10000ms once per 10s.

**Filter mode:** Evaluated on every flush against rows that actually changed since the last tick. Same validation as the REST list endpoint (timeframe, search length, list size caps). `search` is a case-insensitive substring match on `title` (not FTS). No sort / limit — you get every matching row that changed.

**Ids mode:** Filter by explicit `event_slugs` and/or `event_ids`. Max 500 ids per subscription. Updates push when a matching event changes.

**When updates fire:** updates are sent when matching event rows change. Quiet events produce zero messages.

polymarket_markets_stream.title: Markets Stream
polymarket_markets_stream.summary: Real-time Polymarket markets stream — filter or ids mode, 500ms to 10s cadence
polymarket_markets_stream.description:
Low-latency push feed of market rows — same row shape `GET /polymarket/market` returns, including per-outcome price with `latest_block` + `latest_confirmed_at` watermarks. The stream sends updates for open markets as market data, prices, and activity change.

**Seeding:** No initial snapshot is pushed on subscribe. Clients seed from `GET /polymarket/market` and then apply deltas from this stream.

**Subscription model:** A client has up to 8 active slots per room (4 cadences × 2 modes). Re-subscribing to the same `(interval_ms, mode)` replaces the previous subscription. Unsubscribe one slot with `action: "unsubscribe" + interval_ms + mode`, or clear everything with `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

**Cadence (`interval_ms`):** `500`, `1000`, `3000`, or `10000`.

**Filter mode:** Same validation as the REST list endpoint (timeframe, search length, list caps). `search` is a case-insensitive substring match on `title`. No sort / limit — you get every matching row that changed.

**Ids mode:** Any combination of `condition_ids`, `market_slugs`, and `event_slugs` (matches all child markets of those events). Max 500 total per subscription.

**When updates fire:** updates are sent when matching market rows change. Quiet markets produce zero messages.

**Outcome prices:** Each outcome in `outcomes[]` carries `latest_block` and `latest_confirmed_at` (Unix seconds) — the block/ts of the most recent price update. Consumers can use these to reject out-of-order price merges locally.

polymarket_oracle_events.assertion_made.title: Assertion Made

DirtyKind.description:
What triggered a position update. Each value is serialised as a
lowercase string in the `dirty_kinds` array on every payload, and
the same values are accepted as a subscribe-time filter on rooms
that expose one.

* `trade` — a buy, sell, merge, split, redemption, or NegRisk
  convert landed for the position
* `price` — the outcome price moved (mark-to-market refresh)
* `window` — a 1d / 7d / 30d rolling window boundary was crossed
* `position_resolved` — the market that owns this position resolved
  on this update
* `market_resolved` — the market itself resolved (stamped on
  `MarketRollup` rows for lifetime holders who never redeemed).
  Carried on the resolution tick stream and on any full-row update
  that bundles a resolution with a trade.
